title.narrative: Preparation of Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Corridors 5 and 6 (Salang Corridor) Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will assist the Government of Afghanistan in preparing the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridors 5 and 6 (Salang Corridor) Project (ensuing project). The ensuing project will rehabilitate and upgrade the Salang Corridor - one of the few viable land routes linking the north and south of Afghanistan. The project will support the government in (i) studying the feasibility of three alignment options for the rehabilitation and upgrade of the Salang Corridor; and (ii) completing the detailed engineering design, procurement documentation, and project and safeguard documents for the selected option.
Ensuing project to upgrade the Salang Corridor is designed and procured, ready for implementation

Output: Feasibility studies on three alignment options completed Indicator: By 2019 feasibility studies based broadly on three 2012 USAID options updated, covering engineering, geotechnical, financial, economic, environmental, and social aspects (2016 baseline: none) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Phase 1 of the work involves preparing a feasibility study through a review of four alignment options. This was completed on 13 June 2019 (from original target of October 2017), and an optimal alignment was chosen, linking Jabal Seraj and Khinjan through 81 km of new and existing road improvements, as well as a new 6.5 km of twin tunnel sections. MPW immediately instructed the Consultant to proceed with Phase 2, which consists of the preparation of detailed engineering design on this recommended alignment. Phase 2 was originally planned to be completed by April 2020, but the Consultant requested for an extension to the completion date until November 2020 due to travel restrictions as a result of COVID-19.
ADB mission held in Dubai from 12-15 June 2019 between MPW, ADB, the Consultant, and IPC concluded the findings of the feasibility study and selected one alignment option for the Salang Corridor Project. The consultant was tasked to proceed with the detailed design for the selected alignment (option 2).
A Detailed Design meeting was held in Dubai from 10-12 April 2019 between PMO, MPW, ADB, the Consultant, and IPC. The details of the discussions would be presented in a separate Minutes of Discussion. The objectives of the meeting are to refine the option selection, focusing on the recommended option (Option 2)
The contract with the Consultant was signed on 8 July 2017. The consultant mobilized on 28 August 2017. Inception report submitted to ADB in September 2017.
